Name: BlueKeep - RDP Exploit
Desc: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Remote Desktop Services when an unauthenticated attacker connects to the target system using RDP.

Name: Zerologon - Netlogon Privilege Escalation
Desc: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller.

Name: EternalBlue - SMB v1 Exploit
Desc: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the Microsoft Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) server handles certain requests.

Name: Credential Stuffing / Brute Force
Desc: Attackers can perform automated attacks against authentication mechanisms to gain unauthorized access.

Name: COM Elevation of Privilege
Desc: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in Windows due to how the Windows COM Server handles objects in memory.

Name: PrintNightmare
Desc: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows Print Spooler service improperly performs privileged file operations.
